title: Brookfield to acquire India’s PGP Glass from Blackstone for $1.7-billion
html:
A person goes down the escalator at Brookfield Place in Toronto.Nathan Denette/The Canadian Press

Brookfield Asset Management BAM-T said on Monday it has agreed to acquire Indian glass packaging manufacturer PGP Glass from Blackstone BX-N for US$1.7-billion.

PGP Glass manufactures glass packaging for cosmetics, fragrances, spirits, food and pharmaceutical products.

“We welcome Brookfield and look forward to working with them to accelerate our next phase of growth and value creation,” PGP Glass CEO Vijay Shah said.

PGP Glass has 13 furnaces and a production capacity of more than 1,800 tonnes per day, according to its website. It operates across markets including Brazil, India, and the U.K.

New York-based Brookfield Asset Management manages more than US$1-trillion across asset classes including infrastructure, renewable power, private equity, real estate and credit.
summary: Indian glass packaging manufacturer operates in markets including India, Brazil and the U.K.
